title: Universal table templates
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a template type with constructors for a prefix marker, a zero-group marker carrying a Boolean, a dummy marker, a final marker, a cell marker carrying an index in $\mathrm{Fin}(k)$, a Boolean, and a phase in $\mathrm{Fin}(5)$, an input marker carrying a Boolean and an instruction phase, and a snapshot marker carrying a Boolean.
